description: Built-in global presets (Q70): each names one preset per token category. "theme" means the category's own theme preset (what the token source declares). Category presets themselves live with their category: colour in tokens/colour-presets.json, type in fonts/registry.json, icons in icons/sets/index.json, space and shape in tokens/space-shape-options.json, material (frosted or solid, Q73) in the app's material store. Built-in presets are read-only; people's own presets are saved in the browser.
